text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap stands quietly on the rooftop,
gazing intently at the distant scenery.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: What were you doing in a place like this?
What were you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking about my hometown.
I wonder how everyone is doing...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mm... That cloud's shape
kind of looks like Shige-san.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Over there is Tome-san... and
over that way is... doteyaki. *sigh*...

Perhaps due to homesickness, Oguri Cap
seemed to be off her game today.
